job: Read the list of things that happened, with the unread ones marked.
purpose: A row in the notifications popover: a title, a line of text and a time, with an accent dot when unread. The popover has Mark all read, an All / Unread switch, a category select and an empty state. The count on the bell follows the unread rows through data-fd-unread-count.
useWhen: A bell opens a list of finished jobs, monitor changes and billing alerts.
Items must be marked read one by one or all at once.

avoidWhen.when: A message about the account on every page.

states.name: unread
states.how: data-unread on the row; shows an accent dot

keyboard.does: Closes the popover and returns focus to the bell.
Moves through the rows and actions.
